verdict.rationale: New Relic AI is documented as a first-party natural-language assistant that lets users ask questions, troubleshoot, and get help building NRQL queries directly inside the platform, plus a stated move toward automated remediation and an MCP server that surfaces AI-driven context/ops. This directly matches the story of getting AI-generated insights/suggestions from data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the AI assistant's actual output quality and evidence of the 'automated remediation' claim being operational rather than aspirational.
